The [[Warrick family/Legends|Warricks]], a family of [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] from the [[Tree/Legends|forest]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] lived in a '''hut''' at the ground level of [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the Warricks allowed the lost [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Youngling/Legends|younglings]] [[Cindel Towani|Cindel]] and [[Mace Towani]] to stay with them in their home.<ref name="Caravan of Courage: An Ewok Adventure">''[[Caravan of Courage: An Ewok Adventure]]''</ref>

The hut's common room was equipped with a primitive [[fireplace]], a hammock and a round tree stump used as a table.<ref name="Caravan of Courage: An Ewok Adventure" />
